headline: Nigerian Army Regains Control Of X Account Two Months Post-Hack
metaDescription: The Nigerian Army has successfully reclaimed access to its official account on the platform formerly known as Twitter after a two-month security breach.
aiSummaryBullets: The Nigerian Army restored access to its official X account on November 8, 2026.
The account had remained under unauthorized control for approximately two months following a hack.
Authorities confirmed the recovery of the profile, ending a prolonged period of potential impersonation or mismanagement.
aiContextParagraph: The Nigerian Army successfully recovered its official social media presence on the platform X on November 8, 2026. This recovery concludes a period of two months during which the military body lacked access to its verified account following a reported security breach. The incident raised concerns regarding potential unauthorized activity or misinformation originating from the compromised handle during the downtime. Both the military leadership and digital security observers had monitored the situation since the initial hack occurred. With the recovery now finalized, the institution has regained the ability to disseminate official information and engage with the public through its verified handle. While the immediate recovery provides closure to this specific security lapse, the event highlights the ongoing challenges faced by government institutions in maintaining digital integrity and securing high-profile online accounts against persistent cyber threats.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent media outlets, reflecting public interest in the security of official government communication channels.
